scripts.dev:agent: cd apps/agent && RELOAD=true python -m uv run python main.py
scripts.start:agent: cd apps/agent && python -m uv run python main.py
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: bun run --cwd apps/admin test:unit && bun run --cwd apps/telegram-bot test:unit && apps\agent\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -c apps/agent/pyproject.toml tests/unit/agent
scripts.test:integration: bun run --cwd apps/admin test:integration && bun run --cwd apps/telegram-bot test:integration && apps\agent\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -c apps/agent/pyproject.toml tests/integration/agent
